# C4-V7FT-20261017: world-model fixes (merge calibration) + policy-setting fixes; overnight on gpuR

Owner decisions on 2026-10-17 (~00:30):
- Option A: a new WM version, v7ft, fine-tuned from v5m with the fixes (~3 h).
- The policy starts from scratch (no MAPPO init).
- Focus on improving the world model, then a short test of whether a better policy follows.
- GPU: gpuR (RTX 4090), because gpuW had no GPU available.

## Closest prior work
- C4-V5-20261014: v5 / v5m, the Dreamer loop, refreshes 1锟?.
- C4-DIAG-20261016: laptop diagnosis. Findings:
  - the WM's merge is too congested (merge-zone HDV speed 锟? to 锟?.7 m/s, discharge 锟? to 锟? %);
  - the policy fails to accelerate out of the merge;
  - TTC safety cost on all pairs against an absolute budget;
  - alpha collapse;
  - the lane head is untrained.

## What changes
- **WM:** merge-zone speed and discharge calibration losses; policy-episode data (refresh-4 pool, 750 episodes) in
  the training mix.
- **Policy:** TTC on CAV pairs and relative to native; Lagrangian scaled; alpha floor; lane control left to SUMO; a
  merge-discharge reward term.

## Comparators and pre-set criteria (v7ft must beat v5m on all four)
1. Merge-zone speed and discharge error vs SUMO halved.
2. Unseen-wall errors at 10/30/60/120 s and blow-ups no worse (paired CIs, same 36 worlds).
3. Controller ranking: closer to SUMO than v5m. It must see the after-loop policy as worse than native, and
   PI/max-accel as better.
4. On held-back policy traffic: delay and discharge closer to SUMO.

## Budget
- gpuR: one v7ft fine-tune (~3 h), then one short from-scratch policy run (~3 h) only if criteria 1锟? pass.
- Laptop SUMO: training-block seeds 969900锟?69999 only.
  - ranking episodes: 6 controllers 脳 48 episodes;
  - the post-run policy check: 锟?200 short episodes.
- No final-evaluation seeds.

Code defects found (I verified #1 by reading the code): (1) censor_mask compares the absolute step with a local bound -> censored survival EMPTY in every chunk with c0 > 0 (i.e. all but the first chunk; at 300 s with 60-step truncation 9 of 10 chunks); (2) compatibility only prefix-persistent within a chunk (cars can regain eligibility); (3) event term does not require feasibility and sums survival AFTER the recorded event; (4) early merge can be scored without a compatible prefix; (5) Gauss-Hermite latent mixing restarts each chunk; (6) TF mixes per row with location 0 / no residual. Also: '~all censored' is not 'no events' (step 60: 12 censored AND 10 events). Recipe: exact per-car discrete-time survival on supported prefixes (rollout) + same per-car sequence likelihood on recorded states; persistent latent posterior across chunks; temperature FROZEN at the fitted value; residual frozen at 0; sigma/location regularisers 1e-3; TF:on-policy 0.6:0.4 with fixed normalisers; tolerances unchanged unless the diagnosis justifies; slow residual later. Gates: |median timing| <= 2 s, stuck <= 9.8, blow-ups <= 5.2, ranking k=3 non-inferior (LB > -0.02), TTC<3 s <= 1.5 %, no worse level. Yield loss is wired separately (compose.py) - OK.

  **Executable STOP band (frozen).** One monitoring window = one completed training update.

  window w with |G_w| > 0 gated rows, compute with the S-EXPLOIT machinery
  (`exploit.joint_credit` / `ensemble_tail_credit` metrics, detached):
  
  1. *K8-q10 band.* Per gated row r, from its own K8 joint credits `joint[:, H_long, r]`
     (signed paired objective, reward = -J): band_lo = q10, band_hi = q90 (linear
     interpolation, the registered antiexploit QUANTILE=0.10 convention). The row's imagined
     improvement is `-joint` (positive = predicts gain).

     (WM2 `b8797242鈥, WM3 `41e18f09鈥, plus the best non-chosen overnight WM if loadable);
     agreement_w = fraction of rows where EVERY member's q10 also predicts a gain (q10
     improvement > 0), i.e. no member's pessimistic tail sees harm.
  
  **STOP condition.** Window w trips iff
  `median_r(-joint[K8, H_long, r]) > band_hi median` (the claimed improvement exceeds the
  row's own K8 uncertainty band 鈥?optimism) OR `agreement_w < 0.80`. HALT A-LONGX when 3

  metrics are appended per-update to `exploit_windows.jsonl`; the halt is mechanical, never
  efficacy-based, and the stopped fork's checkpoints are retained.
